scripts.dev: npm run build -w @wqi/contracts && concurrently -k -n contracts,api,web "npm run dev -w @wqi/contracts" "npm run dev -w @wqi/server" "npm run dev -w @wqi/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @wqi/contracts && npm run build -w @wqi/server && npm run build -w @wqi/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @wqi/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.admin:create: npm run build -w @wqi/contracts && npm run admin:create -w @wqi/server
